label: copy phase: fed-back token u near the end of a short sequence
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost only when the input is the fed-back token u (99% of activation mass; the rest is on fed-back n). It never fires in the original or delimiter phase, and never on the first occurrence of a token. Only about 10% of copy-phase u inputs fire. Firing is concentrated in the last two copy steps (to_go <= 1) of short sequences (L = 3-6, mostly L = 4-5). The strongest activations come when the next output is n or u (e.g. l u n n <DEL> l [u]); out_tok n has 11.7x lift. Many u inputs that fit the conditions stay silent, and no simple variable separates them, so precision is incomplete. Copy-phase u alone gets mass recall 0.99 but precision 0.10.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: u, n, -, c, g, z; least: m, o, p, t) and the token being output (most: n, u, f, w, i, g; least: z, -, 3, m); timing cues that raise it most: L=4 & t=6, recall_idx=3, L=3.
